summary: Dirt pull-off on a bush-backed bend; nearest house 24 m away across the road.
reasons: Bush behind, dirt verge beside lane
Wide bare ground to pull off

drivers.seclusion: Bush and trees on the west side; houses 24 m and more away on the far side of the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Bare dirt verge about as wide as the lane runs beside the bend, so a van can pull fully off.
drivers.traffic: Quiet-looking residential bend; some passing cars.
drivers.convention: No signs, no other vehicles seen.

flags: Slope about 5% mean, 10% max over 11 m
sun_shade: Dense bush canopy over and west of the verge; shaded most of the day.

best_section.where: West side of the Crag Road bend, on the bare dirt verge
